questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: The search dropdown under 'toyota' plus the car cards behind it read as a car search.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The tinted 'Search with AI' row sits first in the dropdown, above the plain 'toyota wish in Used Cars' suggestions.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Search with AI' / 'Looking for a mainstream Japanese MPV from Toyota, family hauler.' reads like a query to run, not that it opens a side drawer conversation.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'COE Car' and 'Direct owner' tags are terms SG car buyers already use.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: Only the keyword they typed is needed; the suggestions are optional.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Filters are behind 'More filters' and the AI is one row, not a panel up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Every element (suggestions, car cards, 'All of Singapore') is about finding a car.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Suggestions are short one-line rows and car cards are title plus price.
